Rajya Sabha member's son in soup after Aston Martin crash kills woman in Hyderabad
articles.summary: Madhapur police booked Lingamaneni Sanjush, son of MP Lingamaneni Ramesh, for rash driving. His Aston Martin allegedly killed a 26-year-old mall employee near Inorbit Mall on August 16.

Joe Root scripts history, becomes first player to achieve this feat
articles.summary: In a groundbreaking achievement, Joe Root has scored 3,000 runs as captain in the World Test Championship, marking a historic moment during England's first Test against Pakistan at Headingley. Root's remarkable batting skills have firmly established him atop the WTC captaincy run charts.

articles.title: Lindsay Clancy Trial: Candace Owens says she is ‘obviously not guilty’; closing arguments near
articles.summary: Candace Owens has called Lindsay Clancy “obviously not guilty,” blaming doctors and multiple psychiatric medicines for what she described as an induced psychosis. Clancy admits killing her three children but argues severe postpartum psychosis left her not criminally responsible.

articles.title: Owens Rips TPUSA Narrative: Viral post fuels clash over Tyler Robinson case; influencers face scrutiny
articles.summary: Candace Owens is facing renewed attention after Grace Ashford shared a post accusing Erika Kirk and Turning Point USA of dismissing critics who question inconsistencies surrounding Tyler Robinson’s case. Owens challenged statements about Charlie Kirk’s final communications and argued that Robinson remains innocent until proven guilty.

articles.title: Influencer Faces Criminal Charges: US realtor arrested after fire probe; videos central to case
articles.summary: Meliza Campos-Sanchez, a 26-year-old influencer and realtor, is facing serious charges after authorities investigated an alleged kitchen fire and disturbing incidents involving her two young daughters. Police reportedly cited social media videos and evidence recovered from the home.

articles.title: TikTok Star Death Probe: French police investigate burned body of Sonia Bellina; suspect remains in custody
articles.summary: Sonia Bellina, a 29-year-old TikTok creator with more than 260,000 followers, was found dead in a French vineyard after going missing on August 10. Her burned body was discovered two days later and identified through DNA.

articles.title: MIT engineers built a small room-temperature device that generates paired radio waves; a message encoded in one signal could be decoded only with its matching partner
articles.summary: MIT researchers have demonstrated a room-temperature method for generating strongly correlated microwave signals using a magnetic film and microwave resonator, potentially overcoming a major limitation of existing quantum systems that require expensive cryogenic cooling. The technology could have applications in secure wireless communication, quantum radar and high-precision sensing.

articles.title: Will sports become a fundamental right for children? Supreme Court hearing raises a bigger question about screen time
articles.summary: The Supreme Court is examining whether sports and physical literacy should be recognised as a fundamental right under Article 21A, amid concerns over children’s growing screen dependence. In the PIL Kanishka Pandey vs Union of India & Ors., recommendations include compulsory sports education and 90 minutes of daily physical activity in schools.

articles.title: His father earned just ₹3,000 a month, he now earns ₹1.5 crore at 24: IIT Bombay graduate Shashank Agarwal’s inspiring journey
articles.summary: At 24, Shashank Agarwal has turned a challenging financial beginning into an extraordinary career milestone. After securing AIR 20 in JEE Advanced and graduating from IIT Bombay, he reportedly earns ₹1.5 crore annually as an Analyst at Zanskar Corporation.

articles.title: From a village in Farrukhabad to IAF: How Ankit Kumar cleared SSB after 12 attempts to become a Flying Officer
articles.summary: Ankit Kumar’s journey from Farrukhabad to becoming an Indian Air Force Flying Officer is a story of extraordinary persistence. The 24-year-old reportedly faced the SSB process 12 times before finally achieving his dream in 2026.

articles.title: 'Awarapan 2' box office collection Day 7: Emraan's film wraps up first week with solid Rs 113 cr
articles.summary: Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' has emerged as a blockbuster sensation, raking in over 113 crore rupees in just one week. Leveraging the buzz of the Independence Day holiday, the film has maintained impressive momentum, heralding a remarkable resurgence for the actor.

articles.title: Film producer Geo Kuttappan passes away
articles.summary: Veteran Malayalam film producer and distributor Geo Kuttappan died at age ninety. He passed away in Kochi after suffering a heart attack early Wednesday morning.

articles.title: Hayden Panettiere's mother calls out 'toxic individual' in death case
articles.summary: Hayden Panettiere's mother spoke about their estrangement and a toxic individual. She believes this person contributed to her daughter's untimely death at thirty-six.

articles.title: 'DC' BO day 14: Lokesh Kanagaraj film earns Rs 1.23 crore
articles.summary: The movie DC experienced a decline in theatrical earnings on its fourteenth day. Its India net collection on Day 14 was Rs 1.23 crore, a decrease from Wednesday.
